intent: A courtly cliff-valkyrie gown in sky blue, cloud white and blue steel — a winged steel helm, a white stomacher and a short white cape over a long bell skirt — that reads from the high camera as one pale blue bell under a white-winged crown.
requests: A brighter cloud white than (184, 194, 204) for cloth: the cape falls in its own shadow and reads grey rather than white at the high camera.
A tapered or wedge-shaped gore piece: boxes make the skirt a faceted bell with a stepped hem instead of one smooth cone.
A thin two-sided cloth material for the skirt gores: boxes need 0.09 thickness, so their edges read as plates from above.
